name: release-conversation-assistant
description: Release workflow for conversation-assistant: bumps package.json, writes CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog), commits and tags locally, builds and verifies the signed Mac app, deploys it to production (push and GitHub Release, which installed copies update to), and verifies production, plus an [Unreleased] ledger mode.

git.description: Git version control: commits, annotated tags, and pushes the release

node.description: Node.js runtime: reads the version from package.json

gh.description: GitHub CLI: creates the GitHub Release that publishes the Mac app (Step 9 only)

npm.description: npm: bumps package.json and package-lock.json and runs the release gates
